name: Rayburn Farm
description: In 136 Dillingham Road, NC, Rayburn Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
